exposure: pregnancies conceived by assisted reproductive technology
cohort: Pregnant women admitted for spontaneous intraperitoneal hemorrhage during pregnancy and up to 42 days postpartum between November 2017 and March 2020 from maternity units in nine Italian regions.
finding: Spontaneous hemoperitoneum in pregnancy is a rare, life-threatening condition associated with maternal age >=35 years, multiple pregnancies and assisted reproductive technology.
